judged_text: String#scrub does not exist on Ruby 2.0, which this codebase's Gemfile_rails4.lock-era Discourse installs run on (scrub was added in Ruby 2.1). On the supported Ruby version, every feed poll raises NoMethodError (undefined method `scrub' for String) after the network fetch succeeds, so feed importing never works and the hourly job fails on every run.
